newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo December unemployment at 14.2 pct-Dieese.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo December unemployment at 14.2 pct-Dieese.

text.p: The Labor Union Statistics Institute (Dieese) reported the unemployment rate in the city of Sao Paulo during December dropped to 14.2 percent, from 14.5 percent in November.
The average annual unemployment rate, however, rose to 15.1 percent in 1996 from 13.2 percent in 1995.
It was the second worst annual result since Dieese began measuring unemployment in Sao Paulo in 1985. The highest average annual unemployment rate was in 1992, hitting 15.2 percent, Dieese added.
In December 1996, the number of unemployed workers reached 1.208 million, slightly down from 1.240 million in November, it said in a statement.
December figures, however, rose against the same month in 1995 when the share of unemployed workers was 13.2 percent of the workforce, or 1.094 million workers, it added.
